0.description: You wish for <hex:022903EA0203> to unlearn an ability? Very well, if you would be so kind as to specify the undesired ability...

1.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACEFORGETABILITY_00229_001_Q1
1.description: Are you certain you wish for your race chocobo to unlearn <hex:022818FF1343686F636F626F526163654162696C697479E8030103>?

4.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACEFORGETABILITY_00229_001_DONE
4.description: And with that, the process is complete. I pray this meets with your satisfaction.

5.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACEFORGETABILITY_00229_TALK_ACTOR
5.description: You wish for your race chocobo to unlearn an ability? Very well, if you would be so kind as to specify the undesired ability...

6.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACEFORGETABILITY_00229_ERROR_001_01
6.description: No, this cannot be right, can it? According to my records, you do not even have a registered race chocobo.

7.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACEFORGETABILITY_00229_ERROR_001_02
7.description: Race chocobos cannot unlearn abilities until they have been officially registered.

8.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACEFORGETABILITY_00229_ERROR_002_01
8.description: You did remember to bring a bottle of lethe water, did you not? If not, I fear we cannot proceed.

9.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACEFORGETABILITY_00229_ERROR_002_02
9.description: Abilities cannot be unlearned without lethe water, which can be purchased from the tack & feed trader at the race counter.

10.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACEFORGETABILITY_00229_ERROR_003_01
10.description: Hm. So far as I can tell, your race chocobo possesses no abilities which can be unlearned.

11.name: TEXT_CMNGSCCHOCOBORACEFORGETABILITY_00229_ERROR_003_02
11.description: Hereditary abilities are permanent. Only acquired abilities may be unlearned.
